sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning download | SourceForge.net
sources.snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 is an open large language model optimized for efficient autonomous agents, sub-agent deployments, and local inference. It uses a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture combining Mamba-2, MoE, and selected attention layers, with 30B total parameters but only 3B active during inference.
